boxCenter;\n111\t\n112\t    // Triangle edges\n113\t    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n114\t    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n115\t    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n116\t\n117\t    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n118\t    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n119\t        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n120\t    };\n121\t\n122\t    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n123\t    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n124\t\n125\t    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n126\t    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n127\t\n128\t    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n129\t    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n130\t\n131\t    // Test triangle normal\n132\t    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n133\t    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n134\t    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n135\t              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n136\t              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n137\t    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n138\t\n139\t    // Test 9 edge cross products\n140\t    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n141\t        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n142\t        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n143\t        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n144\t        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n145\t                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n146\t                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n147\t        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n148\t        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n149\t    };\n150\t\n151\t    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n152\t    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n153\t    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n154\t        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n155\t            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n156\t            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n157\t                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n158\t            }\n159\t        }\n160\t    }\n161\t\n162\t    return true;\n163\t}\n164\t\n165\t// ============================================================================\n166\t// Octree for Spatial Acceleration\n167\t// ============================================================================\n168\t\n169\tconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\n170\tconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n171\t\n172\tclass Octree {\n173\tpublic:\n174\t    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n175\t    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n176\t    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n177\t    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n178\t    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n179\t\n180\t    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n181\t\n182\t    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n183\t        allTriangles = &triangles;\n184\t        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n185\t\n186\t        // Compute bounding box\n187\t        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n188\t        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n189\t        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n190\t            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n191\t                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n192\t                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n193\t                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n194\t                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n195\t                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n196\t                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n197\t            }\n198\t        }\n199\t\n200\t        // Collect all indices\n201\t        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n202\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n203\t\n204\t        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n205\t    }\n206\t\n207\tprivate:\n208\t    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n209\t        minBound = nodeMin;\n210\t        maxBound = nodeMax;\n211\t        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n212\t        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n315\t// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n316\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i reflectivity);\n571\t\n572\t    // Initialize matrices\n573\t    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n574\t    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t            if (i == j) continue;\n598\t            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n599\t                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n600\t        }\n601\t        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\npublic:\n    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n\n        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n    template<typename Func>\n    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Otherwise, descend to children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n\n    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n        }\n        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n\n                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n            }\n\n            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n        }\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n                sum += pS * pB;\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    printf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"===================================\\n\");\n    printf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    printf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n    printf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n    printf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Initialize\n    SimulationState state;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            newFaces.reserve(faces.size() * 4);\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.resize(faces.size());\n        #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t f = 0; f < faces.size(); ++f) {\n            const auto& face = faces[f];\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles[f] = Triangle(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device-side geometry\n// ============================================================================\n\n// 64-byte aligned triangle record for vectorized loads\nstruct alignas(16) DTri {\n    float4 a, b, c, n;\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Counter-based RNG: reproduces the uniform [0,1) sampling of the reference\n// implementation, but as a stateless function of (triangle i, triangle j, ray)\n// so that results are independent of the number of ranks/threads.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n__device__ __forceinline__ uint64_t splitmix64(uint64_t x) {\n    x += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ULL;\n    uint64_t z = x;\n    z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9ULL;\n    z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBULL;\n    return z ^ (z >> 31);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float u32ToUnit(uint32_t x) {\n    // 24-bit mantissa uniform in [0,1), matching float canonical generation\n    return static_cast<float>(x >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Ray / geometry primitives (device)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 operator+(const float3& a, const float3& b) {\n    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);\n}\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 operator-(const float3& a, const float3& b) {\n    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);\n}\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 operator*(const float3& a, float s) {\n    return make_float3(a.x * s, a.y * s, a.z * s);\n}\n__device__ __forceinline__ float dot3(const float3& a, const float3& b) {\n    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;\n}\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 cross3(const float3& a, const float3& b) {\n    return make_float3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);\n}\n__device__ __forceinline__ float3 xyz(const float4& v) { return make_float3(v.x, v.y, v.z); }\n\n// Moller-Trumbore ray-triangle intersection; returns FLT_MAX on miss\n__device__ __forceinline__ float rayTriangleIntersectD(const float3& orig, const float3& dir,\n                                                       const float3& v0, const float3& v1,\n                                                       const float3& v2) {\n    float3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    float3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    float3 pvec = cross3(dir, e2);\n    float det = dot3(e1, pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return CUDART_INF_F_PLACEHOLDER;\n\n    float invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    float3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    float u = dot3(tvec, pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F_PLACEHOLDER;\n\n    float3 qvec = cross3(tvec, e1);\n    float v = dot3(dir, qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return CUDART_INF_F_PLACEHOLDER;\n\n    return dot3(e2, qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// Segment vs. AABB overlap test (identical to the host octree test)\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBoxD(const float3& p1, const float3& p2,\n                                                  const GNode& n) {\n    float3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    float3 c = p1 + d - n.center;\n    float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > n.half.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > n.half.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > n.half.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > n.half.y * ad.z + n.half.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > n.half.z * ad.x + n.half.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > n.half.x * ad.y + n.half.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Octree-accelerated occlusion query between two sample points\n__device__ bool isRayBlockedD(const float3& from, const float3& to,\n                              const GNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                              const int* __restrict__ nodeTris,\n                              const DTri* __restrict__ tris,\n                              int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    float3 dir = to - from;\n    float rayLen = sqrtf(dot3(dir, dir));\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    float inv = 1.0f / rayLen;\n    float3 dirNorm = dir * inv;\n\n    int stack[64];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const GNode& n = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (n.triCount > 0) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < n.triCount; ++k) {\n                int idx = nodeTris[n.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const DTri& t = tris[idx];\n                float dist = rayTriangleIntersectD(from, dirNorm, xyz(t.a), xyz(t.b), xyz(t.c));\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int ch = n.child[c];\n                if (ch >= 0 && rayIntersectsBoxD(from, to, nodes[ch])) {\n                    stack[sp++] = ch;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float cosPhiD(const float3& v, float vNorm, const float3& normal) {\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return 0.0f;\n    return fmaxf(0.0f, dot3(v, normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Kernel: form factors (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n//\n// Grid: (ceil(N*NUM_RAYS / blockDim.x), numRows).  Each group of NUM_RAYS\n// consecutive threads cooperatively evaluates one (i, j) pair, one ray each.\n\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(128) void kijKernel(int N, int rowBegin, int numRows,\n                                                 const DTri* __restrict__ tris,\n                                                 const GNode* __restrict__ nodes,\n                                                 const int* __restrict__ nodeTris,\n                                                 float* __restrict__ kij) {\n    const int li = blockIdx.y;\n    if (li >= numRows) return;\n    const int i = rowBegin + li;\n\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (NUM_RAYS - 1);\n    const int slot = threadIdx.x / NUM_RAYS;\n    const int j = blockIdx.x * (blockDim.x / NUM_RAYS) + slot;\n    if (j >= N) return;\n\n    const DTri triI = tris[i];\n    const DTri triJ = tris[j];\n\n    float contrib = 0.0f;\n\n    // Skip self pairs, and cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (i != j && dot3(xyz(triI.n), xyz(triJ.n)) <= 0.99f) {\n        // Sample a random point in each triangle (barycentric, folded)\n        uint64_t ctr = ((static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * static_cast<uint64_t>(N) +\n                         static_cast<uint64_t>(j)) * NUM_RAYS + lane) * 2ULL;\n        uint64_t r0 = splitmix64(ctr);\n        uint64_t r1 = splitmix64(ctr + 1ULL);\n\n        float u0 = u32ToUnit(static_cast<uint32_t>(r0));\n        float v0 = u32ToUnit(static_cast<uint32_t>(r0 >> 32));\n        float u1 = u32ToUnit(static_cast<uint32_t>(r1));\n        float v1 = u32ToUnit(static_cast<uint32_t>(r1 >> 32));\n\n        if (u0 + v0 > 1.0f) { u0 = 1.0f - u0; v0 = 1.0f - v0; }\n        if (u1 + v1 > 1.0f) { u1 = 1.0f - u1; v1 = 1.0f - v1; }\n\n        float3 ia = xyz(triI.a);\n        float3 ja = xyz(triJ.a);\n        float3 pI = ia + (xyz(triI.b) - ia) * u0 + (xyz(triI.c) - ia) * v0;\n        float3 pJ = ja + (xyz(triJ.b) - ja) * u1 + (xyz(triJ.c) - ja) * v1;\n\n        float3 v = pJ - pI;\n        float distSqr = dot3(v, v);\n        if (distSqr >= EPSILON) {\n            // Evaluate the (cheap) geometric term first: when it vanishes the\n            // ray contributes nothing regardless of visibility.\n            float vNorm = sqrtf(distSqr);\n            float cosI = cosPhiD(v, vNorm, xyz(triI.n));\n            float cosJ = cosPhiD(make_float3(-v.x, -v.y, -v.z), vNorm, xyz(triJ.n));\n            if (cosI > 0.0f && cosJ > 0.0f) {\n                if (!isRayBlockedD(pI, pJ, nodes, nodeTris, tris, i, j)) {\n                    contrib = (cosI * cosJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Reduce the NUM_RAYS lanes belonging to this pair\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int off = NUM_RAYS / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        contrib += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, contrib, off, NUM_RAYS);\n    }\n\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        kij[static_cast<size_t>(li) * N + j] = contrib * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Kernel: time delays (Tau)\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void tauKernel(int N, int rowBegin, int numRows,\n                          const float3* __restrict__ centers,\n                          int* __restrict__ tau) {\n    int j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    int li = blockIdx.y;\n    if (j >= N || li >= numRows) return;\n    int i = rowBegin + li;\n\n    int result = 0;\n    if (i != j) {\n        float3 d = centers[i] - centers[j];\n        float dist = sqrtf(dot3(d, d));\n        result = static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n    }\n    tau[static_cast<size_t>(li) * N + j] = result;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Kernel: count non-zero form factors (validation) and build sim weights\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ void countNonZeroKernel(const float* __restrict__ kij, size_t n,\n                                   unsigned long long* __restrict__ out) {\n    size_t i = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;\n    unsigned long long local = 0;\n    for (; i < n; i += stride) {\n        if (kij[i] > EPSILON) ++local;\n    }\n    // Warp-level reduction before the atomic\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) local += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, local, off);\n    if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0 && local) atomicAdd(out, local);\n}\n\n// Transform Kij into the weights used by the propagation step:\n//   w_ij = min(Kij * area_j, 1)\n__global__ void weightKernel(int N, int numRows, const float* __restrict__ areas,\n                             float* __restrict__ kij) {\n    size_t idx = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    size_t total = static_cast<size_t>(numRows) * N;\n    if (idx >= total) return;\n    int j = static_cast<int>(idx % static_cast<size_t>(N));\n    float k = kij[idx];\n    kij[idx] = (k > 0.0f) ? fminf(k * areas[j], ONE) : 0.0f;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Kernel: one radiosity propagation timestep\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(256) void simKernel(int N, int t, int rowBegin, int numRows,\n                                                 const float* __restrict__ w,\n                                                 const int* __restrict__ tau,\n                                                 const float* __restrict__ rho,\n                                                 float* __restrict__ radB,\n                                                 int srcIdx, int timeOff) {\n    const int li = blockIdx.x;\n    if (li >= numRows) return;\n    const int i = rowBegin + li;\n\n    const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(li) * N;\n    float sum = 0.0f;\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < N; j += blockDim.x) {\n        int tauij = tau[base + j];\n        if (t < tauij) continue;\n        float wij = w[base + j];\n        if (wij <= 0.0f) continue;\n        float radJ = radB[static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij) * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= 0.0f) continue;\n        sum += wij * radJ;\n    }\n\n    // Block reduction\n    __shared__ float sdata[256 / 32];\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) sum += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, sum, off);\n    int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    if (lane == 0) sdata[warp] = sum;\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (warp == 0) {\n        float v = (lane < (int)(blockDim.x >> 5)) ? sdata[lane] : 0.0f;\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int off = 4; off > 0; off >>= 1) v += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, v, off);\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            float emission = (i == srcIdx && t < timeOff) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;\n            radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i] = rho[i] * v + emission;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Kernel: distance estimation via cross-correlation\n// ============================================================================\n\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(128) void distanceKernel(int N, int T, int rowBegin, int numRows,\n                                                      const float* __restrict__ radB,\n                                                      int srcIdx, float* __restrict__ dist) {\n    const int li = blockIdx.x;\n    if (li >= numRows) return;\n    const int i = rowBegin + li;\n\n    extern __shared__ float sh[];\n    float* srcSig = sh;          // T values: source signal\n    float* mySig = sh + T;       // T values: this triangle's signal\n\n    for (int k = threadIdx.x; k < T; k += blockDim.x) {\n        srcSig[k] = radB[static_cast<size_t>(k) * N + srcIdx];\n        mySig[k] = radB[static_cast<size_t>(k) * N + i];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    float bestCorr = 0.0f;\n    int bestT = 0;\n    for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < T; t += blockDim.x) {\n        float sum = 0.0f;\n        for (int tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) sum += srcSig[tt - t] * mySig[tt];\n        if (sum > bestCorr) { bestCorr = sum; bestT = t; }\n    }\n\n    // Block arg-max reduction, ties resolved towards the smaller delay\n    __shared__ float sCorr[128];\n    __shared__ int sT[128];\n    sCorr[threadIdx.x] = bestCorr;\n    sT[threadIdx.x] = bestT;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = blockDim.x >> 1; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < s) {\n            float oc = sCorr[threadIdx.x + s];\n            int ot = sT[threadIdx.x + s];\n            float mc = sCorr[threadIdx.x];\n            int mt = sT[threadIdx.x];\n            if (oc > mc || (oc == mc && ot < mt)) { sCorr[threadIdx.x] = oc; sT[threadIdx.x] = ot; }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        dist[li] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<float>(sT[0]);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix), host mirror\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n\n    // MPI row decomposition\n    int rank = 0, nranks = 1;\n    int rowBegin = 0, numRows = 0;\n    std::vector<int> rowCounts, rowOffsets;\n\n    // Device state\n    DTri* d_tris = nullptr;\n    GNode* d_nodes = nullptr;\n    int* d_nodeTris = nullptr;\n    float3* d_centers = nullptr;\n    float* d_areas = nullptr;\n    float* d_rho = nullptr;\n    float* d_kij = nullptr;         // local rows (later: propagation weights)\n    int* d_tau = nullptr;           // local rows\n    float* d_radB = nullptr;        // full T x N\n    float* d_dist = nullptr;        // local rows\n    unsigned long long* d_scratch = nullptr;\n\n    float* h_rowBuf = nullptr;      // pinned staging buffer (N floats)\n\n    unsigned long long nonZeroKij = 0;\n\n    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    const bool isRoot = (state.rank == 0);\n\n    // Generate mesh (replicated on every rank: cheap compared to O(N^2) work)\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n\n    if (isRoot) printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    if (isRoot) printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity\n    state.rho.assign(N, reflectivity);\n\n    state.radB.assign(timesteps * N, ZERO);\n    state.distances.assign(N, ZERO);\n\n    // Row decomposition over MPI ranks\n    state.rowCounts.resize(state.nranks);\n    state.rowOffsets.resize(state.nranks);\n    for (int r = 0; r < state.nranks; ++r) {\n        int b = static_cast<int>((N * static_cast<size_t>(r)) / state.nranks);\n        int e = static_cast<int>((N * static_cast<size_t>(r + 1)) / state.nranks);\n        state.rowOffsets[r] = b;\n        state.rowCounts[r] = e - b;\n    }\n    state.rowBegin = state.rowOffsets[state.rank];\n    state.numRows = state.rowCounts[state.rank];\n\n    // ---- Device setup ----\n    std::vector<DTri> htris(N);\n    std::vector<float3> hcenters(N);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& t = state.triangles[i];\n        htris[i].a = make_float4(t.a.x, t.a.y, t.a.z, 0.0f);\n        htris[i].b = make_float4(t.b.x, t.b.y, t.b.z, 0.0f);\n        htris[i].c = make_float4(t.c.x, t.c.y, t.c.z, 0.0f);\n        htris[i]._normal_pad();\n        Vec3 c = t.center();\n        hcenters[i] = make_float3(c.x, c.y, c.z);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<GNode> hnodes;\n    std::vector<int> hnodeTris;\n    hnodes.reserve(2 * N + 8);\n    hnodeTris.reserve(8 * N);\n    flattenOctree(&state.octree, hnodes, hnodeTris);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_tris, N * sizeof(DTri)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_nodes, hnodes.size() * sizeof(GNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_nodeTris, std::max<size_t>(1, hnodeTris.size()) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_centers, N * sizeof(float3)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_areas, N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_rho, N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_radB, timesteps * N * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_scratch, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n\n    const size_t local = static_cast<size_t>(state.numRows) * N;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_kij, std::max<size_t>(1, local) * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_tau, std::max<size_t>(1, local) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.d_dist, std::max<size_t>(1, state.numRows) * sizeof(float)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&state.h_rowBuf, N * sizeof(float)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_tris, htris.data(), N * sizeof(DTri), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_nodes, hnodes.data(), hnodes.size() * sizeof(GNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!hnodeTris.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.d_nodeTris,
